Terrible App. I downloaded this app when I was on a job and was having trouble identifying a few plants. I attempted to identify 3 different plants and it didn’t identify any correctly. I then attempted to identify another bush and it identified it incorrectly. 4 times in a row so I gave up on it and used google. I had already paid the 1 year subscription, I attempted to cancel it and Apple would refund me. Told me I had to contact the App creator. I didn’t have time and forgot. I threw away $20 for nothing and never received a refund. I won’t recommend this app until this can be fixed!

DO NOT DOWNLOAD. To be honest I would not download this app. It says you can cancel at anytime. I downloaded it and canceled the same day. It took $3.99 out of my account anyway. I asked to be refunded and they refused to refund. Stay away from this app.
Misleading ad for free trial. Advertises a free week. Charges you right away. Works no better than Google lens. Save your money and headaches

Lousy. Absolute scam. Says cost is 7.99 and a free week. I tried it. Charged me 12.99 and information given on my plants was inaccurate. Within five minutes i cancelled the subscription and charge of 12.99 still went through. Terrible! 

Even better is when they respond with further lies attempting to say that I forgot to cancel my subscription when I clearly stated that I cancelled my subscription 5 minutes after I got it. I was charged the full 12.99 upfront! Again, a scam! And then tried to blame the customer instead of attempting to accept responsibility and fix the situation.

:/. Bought a years subscription to this app after watching constant ads on You Tube about how brilliantly the app identifies plant problems and offers suitable remedy
Immediately took it to a struggling cutting that i hoped was a lost blueberry rooted cutting, recently found in heavy undergrowth, which i then moved to new site. 
Plant AI said it was Japanese knotweed!
i tried again
Plant AI said it was African milk bush
I tried again. Plant AI said it could not identify the plant over and over again
I tried to diagnose the plant
The app wanted me to buy another app which could not identify either

i tried the 2 free apps
Plant finder said it was Sacred Bamboo although did identify a pear tree also struggling in what i hoped would be a fruit hedge
Plant Net agreed that it was a blueberry
Very annoying. Very annoying advertisement, extremely high subscription fees
Poor. Couldn’t identify the first plant I took a photo of ! Mis identified it as a snake plant when it’s an orchid . Not very impressed

Junk app. Literally just says sick plant, takes too long to load the reason and can’t click on the reason why it’s sick to figure out what they need - don’t waste your time regular AI apps have more insight and ability to help for free

Not easy to use as the promo suggests.. The app makes it seem easy to identify issues with a specific plants health. Take a photo, identify problem. Change care plan. Plant thrives. Now your app is giving me very vague instructions , like it may be too much water or not enough water. Make sure the watering is suitable for this plant. They gives me know detailed instructions. Becomes another guessing game.
